column1: (2) An instalment payer shall pay instalments of tax-

required to withhold tax under section 8: in  the  case  of  a  person  whose  year  of
assessment is a twelve month period ending
on the thirty first day of March, on or before
the  fifteenth  day  respectively  of  August,
November  and  February  in  that  year  of
assessment and the fifteenth day of May of
the next succeeding year of assessment; or
in any other case, on or before the fifteenth
commencing at the beginning of each year of
assessment and a final instalment on or before
the fifteenth day after the end of each year of
assessment, unless it coincides with the end
of one of the three-month periods.
